screening.method: Every author screened; binary outcome/evidence terms; top-three cap; two candidates per area; five area nominations then fill to at least 15 retaining cutoff ties. Current leading positions retained for equal re-review. Hash-based ordering schedules review, not impact.

selection_policy.order: Score, then sum of inspected evidence grades, then supported reach across counted initiatives.
selection_policy.evidence_grades: 2: implementation and regression excerpts; 1: implementation/configuration only; 0: guidance only. Tests were not executed. These grades describe inspected support, not certainty of business impact.
selection_policy.ties: Scores retain equal ranks. Cutoff alternatives are disclosed; feature selection expresses a stated evidence/reach preference, not a unique mathematical winner.

sensitivity.limitation: Only tests weights within reviewed evidence; does not correct selection or review-depth bias.
